_source: SFWF Website Copy Deck v1.0, section 12. Copy verbatim.
_publications: Rebuilt entry by entry against the publisher records by Linnea Moritz, 11 September 2026, from the Foundation's publications import sheet. summary lines are not written yet; corrections sheet lists the 49 places the list differs from the old page.

database.lede: Everything Dr. Ingham published, verified against its source and linked. Corrections welcome at info@soilfoodweb.com.
notes: plain-language one-line summaries for each entry, nobody has written them yet. Linnea.
55 entries have no source link. Links or PDFs where they exist. Linnea and Evan.

the five internet articles carry links from the old page that were not re-verified, and one of them (the 2015 carbon sequestration piece) is from Mercola.com and was recommended for removal. Decide before launch. Evan.
the Klebsiella planticola entry merges two entries from the old page and has a public controversy history. Attribution under review. Evan and Alex.
the corrections sheet (49 places the new list differs from the old page, each with its reason) is not published anywhere yet. Decide whether it goes on this page. Linnea.
